title: Kissed Australian Pineapple Crumble
description: A cozy sour crumble featuring sweet pineapple, warm ginger, and a crunchy oat‑almond topping, finished with tempered dark chocolate.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C and lightly grease a 20cm square baking dish with coconut oil.
In a small bowl, toss chopped pineapple with lemon juice, grated ginger, honey, and ground cinnamon until evenly coated.
Spread the pineapple mixture evenly in the prepared dish and set aside.
In another bowl, combine rolled oats, ground almonds, and salt, then cut in the coconut butter until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Sprinkle the oat‑almond crumble over the pineapple layer, pressing lightly to settle.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until the top is golden and the pineapple is bubbling.
While the crumble is baking, melt the dark chocolate chips in a heat‑proof bowl set over a pot of simmering water.
Once the chocolate is fully melted, remove from heat, stir in a pinch of salt, and allow it to temper for 5 minutes before drizzling.
Remove the dish from the oven, let it cool for 5 minutes, then drizzle the tempered chocolate over the warm crumble.
Serve the crumble warm, optionally with a dollop of lactose‑free yogurt or coconut milk.
